# Config reference

Every option in `config.json`, generated from the loading screen's source code for the current release.

You rarely need this page: the [Config Builder](https://loadingscreen.4zam.dev/builder.html) and [Build with AI](https://loadingscreen.4zam.dev/ai.html) write `config.json` for you and show a live preview. Use it when you edit the file by hand.

`config.json` lives at `html/config.json` inside the `4zam_loading` resource. Restart the resource after editing it. Images, videos and audio can be full URLs or paths inside the resource such as `./assets/bg.webm`.

## Fields at a glance

| Field | Type | Builder | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [`language`](#language) | string | Settings menu | Language of the loading-screen text. |
| [`mirrorLayout`](#mirrorLayout) | boolean | config.json only | Mirror the whole layout right to left (panels and watermark swap sides). |
| [`selectedColor`](#selectedColor) | string | Brand & Color | Accent color used across the screen (title highlight, buttons, cards). |
| [`backgroundImage`](#backgroundImage) | string | Background | Background image: a URL or a path inside the resource such as `./assets/bg.png`. |
| [`backgroundVideo`](#backgroundVideo) | string or (string or object)[] or null | Background | Background video. |
| [`videoUrl`](#videoUrl) | string | config.json only | Legacy single-video field from early versions, read only when `backgroundVideo` is absent. |
| [`videoAsAudio`](#videoAsAudio) | boolean | Background | Whether the background video is the audio source. |
| [`watermark`](#watermark) | object | Brand & Color | The server name, subheading and logo shown in the corner of the screen. |
| [`socialHeaders`](#socialHeaders) | object[] | Social Links | Social and link cards in the header (Discord, store and so on). |
| [`rules`](#rules) | string[] | Rules | Server rules shown in the Rules panel, one string per rule. |
| [`teamMembers`](#teamMembers) | object[] | Team | Staff cards shown in the Team panel. |
| [`customPanels`](#customPanels) | object[] | Custom Panels | Extra tabs with your own list content (updates, guides, jobs and so on). |
| [`gallery`](#gallery) | object[] | Gallery | Images in the Gallery panel. |
| [`keyboardShortcuts`](#keyboardShortcuts) | object | Keyboard | Keybind hints shown on the on-screen keyboard. |
| [`music`](#music) | object[] | Music | Music playlist (`.mp3`). |
| [`defaultVolume`](#defaultVolume) | number | Music | Starting player volume, from 0 to 100. |

## `language` { #language }

Language of the loading-screen text. Arabic (`ar`) and Urdu (`ur`) render right to left. Missing or unknown values fall back to English.

**Type:** string, optional.

**Allowed values:** `"en"`, `"en-GB"`, `"es"`, `"de"`, `"fr"`, `"it"`, `"nl"`, `"pl"`, `"pt"`, `"hi"`, `"ar"`, `"ur"`.

**Default:** `"en"`.

Set for you: the builder writes the language you pick in its settings menu.

## `mirrorLayout` { #mirrorLayout }

Mirror the whole layout right to left (panels and watermark swap sides). Independent of `language`, which only changes text direction.

**Type:** boolean, optional.

**Default:** `false`.

Not in the builder: set it in `config.json` by hand.

## `selectedColor` { #selectedColor }

Accent color used across the screen (title highlight, buttons, cards). Hex (`#7C3AED`) or `rgb()`/`rgba()`/`hsl()`/`hsla()`. Anything else falls back to the default.

**Type:** string.

**Default:** `"#FF8A4D"`.

Edit it in the [Config Builder](https://loadingscreen.4zam.dev/builder.html) under **Brand & Color**.

## `backgroundImage` { #backgroundImage }

Background image: a URL or a path inside the resource such as `./assets/bg.png`. Shown when there is no video, or when every video fails.

**Type:** string.

**Default:** `""`.

Edit it in the [Config Builder](https://loadingscreen.4zam.dev/builder.html) under **Background**.

## `backgroundVideo` { #backgroundVideo }

Background video. Either one URL (a local `.webm`/`.mp4` path or a YouTube link) or a list of videos the player can skip between. A video takes priority over `backgroundImage`.

**Type:** string or (string or object)[] or null, optional.

Edit it in the [Config Builder](https://loadingscreen.4zam.dev/builder.html) under **Background**.

| Key | Type | Allowed values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `backgroundVideo[].url` | string |  |  | Video URL: a local `.webm`/`.mp4` path or a YouTube link. |
| `backgroundVideo[].title` | string, optional |  |  | Name shown in the player for this video. Falls back to the watermark title. |
| `backgroundVideo[].subtitle` | string, optional |  |  | Line shown under the title. Falls back to the watermark subheading. |

## `videoUrl` { #videoUrl }

Legacy single-video field from early versions, read only when `backgroundVideo` is absent. Use `backgroundVideo` instead.

**Type:** string, optional.

Not in the builder: set it in `config.json` by hand.

## `videoAsAudio` { #videoAsAudio }

Whether the background video is the audio source. `true`: the player controls the video (play, pause, scrub, volume). `false`: the video loops muted and the player drives the `music` playlist. When omitted, the video is the audio source only if there is no `music` playlist.

**Type:** boolean, optional.

Edit it in the [Config Builder](https://loadingscreen.4zam.dev/builder.html) under **Background**.

## `watermark` { #watermark }

The server name, subheading and logo shown in the corner of the screen.

**Type:** object.

Edit it in the [Config Builder](https://loadingscreen.4zam.dev/builder.html) under **Brand & Color**.

| Key | Type | Allowed values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `watermark.label` | object |  |  | The title line. |
| `watermark.label.text` | string |  |  | The main title text, usually your server name. |
| `watermark.label.colorWordCount` | number |  | `1` | How many words of `text`, counted from the start, get the accent color. |
| `watermark.label.animation` | string, optional | `"none"`, `"wave"`, `"wave-reverse"`, `"bounce"`, `"ripple"`, `"sway"`, `"reveal"`, `"slam"`, `"pulse"` | `"wave"` | Title animation preset. Missing or unknown values use `wave`. |
| `watermark.label.sheen` | boolean, optional |  | `true` | Sweeping light sheen across the title. Set `false` to turn it off. |
| `watermark.subHeading` | string |  |  | Smaller line shown under the title. |
| `watermark.logo` | string |  |  | Logo image: a URL or a path inside the resource. |

## `socialHeaders` { #socialHeaders }

Social and link cards in the header (Discord, store and so on). Cards with `enabled: false` are hidden.

**Type:** object[].

Edit it in the [Config Builder](https://loadingscreen.4zam.dev/builder.html) under **Social Links**.

| Key | Type | Allowed values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `socialHeaders[].type` | string | `"discord"`, `"instagram"`, `"telegram"`, `"youtube"`, `"tiktok"`, `"custom"` |  | Platform icon to show. Use `custom` to supply your own icon image. |
| `socialHeaders[].imagePath` | string, optional |  |  | Custom icon image (URL or resource path). Used with `type: "custom"`. |
| `socialHeaders[].imageWidth` | string, optional |  |  | Custom icon width, any CSS size such as `3vw` or `32px`. |
| `socialHeaders[].imageHeight` | string, optional |  |  | Custom icon height, any CSS size such as `3vh` or `32px`. |
| `socialHeaders[].cardLabel` | string |  |  | Card title. |
| `socialHeaders[].cardInfo` | string |  |  | Short description under the card title. |
| `socialHeaders[].link` | string |  |  | URL opened by the card button. |
| `socialHeaders[].buttonLabel` | string |  |  | Button text. When empty, a localized default such as "Join" is used. |
| `socialHeaders[].enabled` | boolean |  | `true` | Show this card on the screen. |

## `rules` { #rules }

Server rules shown in the Rules panel, one string per rule. Use `\n` for a line break. Five or six short rules read best.

**Type:** string[], optional.

Edit it in the [Config Builder](https://loadingscreen.4zam.dev/builder.html) under **Rules**.

## `teamMembers` { #teamMembers }

Staff cards shown in the Team panel.

**Type:** object[], optional.

Edit it in the [Config Builder](https://loadingscreen.4zam.dev/builder.html) under **Team**.

| Key | Type | Allowed values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `teamMembers[].name` | string |  |  | Display name. |
| `teamMembers[].role` | string |  |  | Role or position shown under the name. |
| `teamMembers[].discord` | string |  |  | Discord username, or any short label. |
| `teamMembers[].image` | string |  |  | Avatar image (URL or resource path); square images look best. |

## `customPanels` { #customPanels }

Extra tabs with your own list content (updates, guides, jobs and so on).

**Type:** object[], optional.

Edit it in the [Config Builder](https://loadingscreen.4zam.dev/builder.html) under **Custom Panels**.

| Key | Type | Allowed values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `customPanels[].panelPosition` | number |  |  | Where the tab sits in the tab row; lower numbers come first. Defaults to the panel's position in the list. |
| `customPanels[].uniqueId` | string |  |  | Unique id for the panel, such as `updates`. Must differ between panels. Defaults to `panel-<n>`. |
| `customPanels[].buttonLabel` | string |  |  | Tab button text. |
| `customPanels[].icon` | string |  |  | Tab icon: a preset icon name such as `gavel` or `bullhorn`, an `fa-` prefixed name, an image URL or path or an inline SVG string. |
| `customPanels[].cardHeaderLabel` | string |  |  | Heading at the top of the panel. |
| `customPanels[].singularLabel` | string |  |  | Label for one entry, such as `Update` or `Tip`. |
| `customPanels[].entries` | string[] |  |  | The list items, one string each. |

## `gallery` { #gallery }

Images in the Gallery panel. Players can open one and browse with the arrow keys.

**Type:** object[], optional.

Edit it in the [Config Builder](https://loadingscreen.4zam.dev/builder.html) under **Gallery**.

| Key | Type | Allowed values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `gallery[].path` | string |  |  | Image URL or resource path; landscape images look best. |

## `keyboardShortcuts` { #keyboardShortcuts }

Keybind hints shown on the on-screen keyboard.

**Type:** object.

Edit it in the [Config Builder](https://loadingscreen.4zam.dev/builder.html) under **Keyboard**.

| Key | Type | Allowed values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `keyboardShortcuts.layout` | string, optional | `"ansi"`, `"iso"`, `"jis"` | `"ansi"` | Physical keyboard layout to draw. |
| `keyboardShortcuts.locale` | string, optional |  |  | Locale for special key labels (`Shift`, `Enter`...), such as `de-DE`. When omitted, follows `language`. |
| `keyboardShortcuts.keys` | object[] |  |  | The highlighted keys. |
| `keyboardShortcuts.keys[].key` | string |  |  | Key name as shown on the overlay, such as `M`, `G` or `Left Arrow`. |
| `keyboardShortcuts.keys[].onFoot` | string or null |  |  | Hint shown while on foot, or `null` for none. |
| `keyboardShortcuts.keys[].inCar` | string or null |  |  | Hint shown while in a vehicle, or `null` for none. |

## `music` { #music }

Music playlist (`.mp3`). Tracks play in order. With no tracks and no video audio, the player is hidden.

**Type:** object[], optional.

Edit it in the [Config Builder](https://loadingscreen.4zam.dev/builder.html) under **Music**.

| Key | Type | Allowed values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `music[].path` | string |  |  | Audio file URL or resource path (`.mp3`). |
| `music[].title` | string |  |  | Track title. |
| `music[].artist` | string |  |  | Artist name. |
| `music[].image` | string or null |  |  | Cover art (URL or resource path), or `null` for none. |

## `defaultVolume` { #defaultVolume }

Starting player volume, from 0 to 100.

**Type:** number.

**Default:** `100`.

Edit it in the [Config Builder](https://loadingscreen.4zam.dev/builder.html) under **Music**.
